purpose: FR-043 + SC-006 + SC-016 — Sentry beforeSend allowlist. Every field NOT in this list is replaced with the literal "[redacted]" before transport. CI fuzz corpus exercises ≥50 synthetic PHI payloads and asserts the wire body contains zero non-allowlisted field names AND that no denylist_regex_against_exception_value pattern survives inside the exception 'value' free-text field (assert on VALUE content, not only field names).
url_handling: Every captured URL (event 'transaction', 'request.url', breadcrumb 'data.url', navigation breadcrumbs) MUST be reduced to a parameterized route template with the fragment stripped: '/emergency/:token' and '/account/...' — never a concrete URL. The emergency-QR AES key lives in the URL fragment (#k=...), so an un-stripped href would leak the decryption key to Sentry. beforeSend + beforeBreadcrumb strip '#...' and tokenized path segments from all URLs.
_denylist_note: Digit classes MUST match Eastern-Arabic-Indic (٠-٩ U+0660..0669) and Extended-Arabic-Indic (۰-۹ U+06F0..06F9) as well as ASCII, because FR-213/SC-209 accept those at input; date patterns MUST cover the DD/MM/YYYY UI mask as well as ISO; clinical keyword classes MUST include Arabic terms because the app is Arabic-first.
ci_fuzz_corpus_includes: synthetic Egyptian 14-digit National IDs (deterministic non-real seeds)
synthetic free-text allergy / condition / medication names in ar-EG + ar-SA + ar-AE + en
vendor: sentry_flutter ^9.0 on Flutter 3.41.9 / Dart 3.11 (self-hosted Sentry server, AGPL-compatible deployment per Constitution Principle XII)
applies_via: Sentry beforeSend + beforeBreadcrumb hooks installed at app boot in lib/core/crash/sentry_init.dart
alarm_path: Any non-allowlisted field observed on the wire fails the build via CI guard test test/phi_leak_fuzz_test/sentry_allowlist_test.dart
